gaps: Fighter Verses Sets 3-5 not captured; fighterverses.com/verse-index returned HTTP 500 and the Truth78 site does not publish the flat lists on fetchable pages. Set 1 transcription shows 51 passages against the officially stated 52 per set — one passage may be missing and could not be verified against the primary source.
Bible Memory app (formerly Scripture Typer): no published, verifiable 'most popular verses' statistics found; biblememory.com returned HTTP 403 to fetches. Omitted rather than inferred.
Simply Charlotte Mason Scripture Memory System is a rotation method (memory box), not a fixed canonical verse list; no verifiable official list found, so omitted.

Awana: only the Sparks HangGlider handbook scope-and-sequence was captured from official awana.org PDFs. Sparks WingRunner/SkyStormer, Cubbies, T&T, Trek, and Journey handbooks have their own verse sequences that were not transcribed; there is no single official 'core verses across clubs' list published by Awana.

Robert J. Morgan's 100 verses were captured via a LearnScripture.net transcription that groups them into 63 passages; the book's own 1-100 numbering was not independently verified against the book text.

No seminary/denominational standard memorization list with a verifiable published verse-by-verse ordering was found in this pass (e.g., catechism memory work is typically Q&A plus proof texts, not a verse list).
notes: All lists are curricula/programs presented in published (pedagogical) order, not ranked; 'ranked': false throughout and position reflects published sequence. References normalized to full book names, 'Psalm' singular; contiguous comma references (e.g. 'Philippians 4:6,7') normalized to ranges; the one non-contiguous TMS reference (Psalm 119:9,11) kept as a comma pair. Primary/authoritative sources: TMS from a US Naval Academy Navigators chapter PDF carrying the official (c) The Navigators chart; Awana from awana.org's official scope-and-sequence PDF; Fighter Verses and Morgan's 100 from LearnScripture.net community transcriptions of the published sets (secondary sources — flagged in gaps where counts differ from official claims).
